decisions.reason: The VMID-to-VSYS topology clarification does not change the USB-C connector or its sourceability constraints.
The topology clarification does not change the battery connector, its NTC pin, placement, orientation, or mounting style.
Connecting VMID and VSYS as shown in the reference does not alter the requirement to monitor battery temperature through the J_BAT NTC connection.
Although this requirement also references the AXP2101, the source decision only resolves the VMID-to-VSYS connection and does not change any battery-protection cutoff or protection-mode rule.
The AXP2101 VMID-to-VSYS topology does not change the MT3608 boost-enable GPIO, pull-down, or powered-load behavior.
The source decision does not change how battery-charge status is indicated or the GPIO used for the indicator.
The clarified AXP2101 net connection does not entail a change to the power board's eight-layer stack.
The electrical topology clarification does not change the board dimensions, enclosure fit, mounting holes, or connector arrangement.
The VMID-to-VSYS connection decision does not alter the independently specified TVS-based ESD protection.
The source decision concerns an internal AXP2101 VMID-to-VSYS connection and does not change the interboard connector architecture, signals, or pin-order policy.
The topology clarification does not necessarily change the deferred BOM part-number and component-role documentation obligations.
The AXP2101 VMID-to-VSYS topology is independent of the I2C clock, pull-ups, cable length, and series-resistor configuration.
